description: List tested patterns with their headline result on one market and timeframe. Filter by name, family, direction or verdict, for example: which chart patterns beat chance on forex 4h. Patterns recorded on both breakout sides have no all row and are not listed: read them with get_pattern_stats.

family.description: Pattern family (harmonic patterns are in chart).

limit.description: Maximum number of patterns returned. Default: 50.

market.description: Market. all pools the markets that have this timeframe. Default: all.

measure.description: move: excess 10-bar return over the rest of the market (verdict). trade: 2:1 trade versus the same trade on random dates (verdictTrade). Default: move.

min_occurrences.description: Keep only results with at least this many occurrences.

query.description: Words of the pattern name, e.g. "engulfing", "head and shoulders".

sort.description: occurrences (default), excess (excess return, best first), trade (expectancy minus its random baseline, best first) or name.

timeframe.description: Bar timeframe. Default: 1d. Stocks, ETFs, indices and commodities have 1d and 1w only.

verdict.description: Keep only this verdict (on the measure chosen with measure).

name: search_patterns
title: Search patterns
